Selected early prototype/protocol tokens, absent declaration order, late split/matchAll bodies, regex caches and lastIndex behavior are preserved. All 3,319 actual regressions pass with no failures/skips, including 82 new owner cases, forty new isolated cases and all 656 standalone cases. Forty-five saved assemblies preserve normalized metadata and 50,076 IL-verified bodies. Final CI covers 22,458 core/standalone cases per platform, with one existing Linux skip and three Windows skips, plus 129 GUI passes each and no failures. Quality and full committed-source/generator binding pass. Two exploratory pre-existing species/custom-exec differences reproduce unchanged with original Node expectations retained separately. No assertions, deadlines, budgets or coverage changed. The late AST-identity hoist registry and complete final audit remain required.
